pull: Clue: Named for a creature with claws
body:
Can you name this tank?

Before dawn on 18 November 1944, British searchlights threw a hazy glow over the fields near Geilenkirchen, Germany, as these mine clearing tanks crawled into a German minefield ahead of the American 84th Infantry Division. Wet mud blunted their work, so engineers with mine detectors followed behind, and at 7 a.m. the infantry advanced through the cleared lanes.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: Sherman Crab flail tank of the 79th Armoured Division under test in Britain, 27 April 1944, flails beating the ground. Sgt J. Mapham, War Office official photographer, IWM H 38080. Crown copyright expired, public domain. Not the Geilenkirchen action itself; same type, same division, same year. No markings visible.
